question: What should I change, and where, to keep both mass and balance within these targets?

result.answer: Proposed: Add ~0.104 kg sealed trim at L (x=-60mm) and remove ~0.054 kg at R (x=+60mm). Why: bound check shows baseline 0.945-0.955 kg, 9.5-10.5mm CG fails both targets; rounded commands give 0.993-1.007 kg and -0.63 to +0.66mm, inside 0.98-1.02 kg and -2 to +2mm, limits fit. Fixed: core, targets, positions, resolution. Next: re-weigh/CG check after exchange; separate retention/durability/tipping checks still needed. Interpretation unverified, numeric result only.

Independent trim stocks and actual addition/removal limits are declared at each location. A no-operation location incurs no adjustment error.
Rigid static mass/moment balance is evaluated over every entered uncertainty corner. Changed geometry or a physical adjustment needs a new observation.
This does not establish tipping safety, sliding, load capacity, containment, material response, durability or future-batch consistency.
